business_problem: SearchKings had a small team supporting thousands of advertising customers and needed a way to automate repetitive campaign-analysis work without losing the personalized service that differentiates the agency.
solution_summary: SearchKings built its internal operating system, Ease, on Google Cloud so account managers could move from manual campaign maintenance to faster, AI-assisted decision-making. The company initially used Google Kubernetes Engine for flexibility, then shifted more of the platform to Cloud Run and Cloud SQL so a lean development team could take advantage of serverless simplicity, autoscaling, and faster deployment. Gemini 3.1 Flash and Gemini 3.1 Pro power tools such as Negative Keyword Suggestion, which ingests campaign context like geography and customer vertical, recommends which search terms to exclude, and keeps a human reviewer in the loop before changes are applied. Around that core, Google Workspace and Firebase support collaboration and earlier product development, while Gemini CLI helps developers in daily work. This architecture lets SearchKings run tens of thousands of reports every day and serve thousands of customers with just over 100 employees.

solution_components.name: Cloud Run

solution_components.name: Cloud SQL
solution_components.role: Supports the structured data layer behind Ease.

solution_components.name: Gemini 3.1 Flash
solution_components.role: Handles faster recommendation and analysis tasks within the campaign-optimization workflow.

solution_components.name: Gemini 3.1 Pro
solution_components.role: Handles deeper recommendation and analysis tasks within Ease.

solution_components.name: Google Workspace
solution_components.role: Supports internal collaboration across the agency's Google-based operations.

solution_components.name: Firebase
solution_components.role: Supported early platform development and introduced the team to the broader Google ecosystem.

solution_components.name: Gemini CLI
solution_components.role: Helps developers work faster inside the Google-based development environment.

data_flow: Campaign and performance data enters the Ease platform, where Cloud Run-hosted services and a Cloud SQL-backed data layer feed Gemini models that analyze context such as geography and customer vertical, generate keyword and workflow recommendations, and return suggestions that account managers approve before acting on them.
business_outcome: SearchKings cut negative-keyword review time from 30 minutes to five, automated campaign-analysis work at scale, and kept personalized service intact for thousands of customers with a team of just over 100 employees.
